title: 光子相位陣列
summary: 從陣列相位、遠場旁瓣與封裝校正拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate array phase, far-field sidelobes and package calibration, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設均勻陣列 d=λ/2，欲偏轉 θ=30°，在所定符號下相鄰相位增量幅值 |Δφ|=2π(d/λ)sinθ=π/2；符號決定左右方向。
workedExample.textEn: Assume a uniform array with d=λ/2 and θ=30°. The adjacent phase-step magnitude is |Δφ|=2π(d/λ)sinθ=π/2; its sign sets left versus right under the chosen convention.
workedExample.assumptions: 均勻直線陣列、遠場、忽略互耦；不是眼安全或最大量距模型。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Uniform linear array in the far field, neglecting mutual coupling; not an eye-safety or maximum-range model.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

quiz.question: 要審查「近遠場轉換」，哪項主張或驗證方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or verification is justified when reviewing near-to-far transformation?
options: 只要相加各天線強度就能算干涉主瓣。
降低旁瓣完全不影響主瓣與效率。
量測距離須滿足採用的遠場近似，否則角度與光斑解讀有偏差。
optionsEn: Adding antenna intensities predicts the interference main lobe.
Reducing sidelobes never affects main lobe or efficiency.
Measurement distance must satisfy the chosen far-field approximation or angle/spot interpretation is biased.
quiz.explanation: 量測距離須滿足採用的遠場近似，否則角度與光斑解讀有偏差。 比較不同觀察距離的正規化光斑，或明示透鏡傅立葉平面。
quiz.explanationEn: Measurement distance must satisfy the chosen far-field approximation or angle/spot interpretation is biased. Compare normalized spots at different distances or explicitly identify a lens Fourier plane.

steps.title: 近遠場轉換：量測與判別
steps.objective: 以「近遠場轉換」區分機制並作出有證據的驗收決定，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate mechanisms and make an evidence-based acceptance decision for near-to-far transformation, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 保留上一作業的模型，現在檢驗它是否足以解釋觀察。比較不同觀察距離的正規化光斑，或明示透鏡傅立葉平面。 記錄原始量、單位、基準與重複量測差異；以支持及否定各一項證據比較「量測距離須滿足採用的遠場近似，否則角度與光斑解讀有偏差。」與錯誤假說「降低旁瓣完全不影響主瓣與效率。」，最後提出放行、重測或修模決定。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the previous model and test whether it explains the observations. Compare normalized spots at different distances or explicitly identify a lens Fourier plane. Record raw quantities, units, reference conditions and repeatability. Use supporting and falsifying evidence to compare "Measurement distance must satisfy the chosen far-field approximation or angle/spot interpretation is biased." against the incorrect hypothesis "Reducing sidelobes never affects main lobe or efficiency."; decide whether to accept, repeat or revise the model.
steps.observation: 比較不同觀察距離的正規化光斑，或明示透鏡傅立葉平面。
steps.observationEn: Compare normalized spots at different distances or explicitly identify a lens Fourier plane.
steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：降低旁瓣完全不影響主瓣與效率。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Reducing sidelobes never affects main lobe or efficiency. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交近遠場轉換的量測判別表：比較不同觀察距離的正規化光斑，或明示透鏡傅立葉平面。 附上基準、重複性或不確定度，及不能由本資料判定的結論。
